newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures finish mixed, long end lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures finish mixed, long end lower.

text.p: July 24 - U.S. debt futures ended mixed, with the long end slightly lower after a quiet session. One analyst said profit-taking was the feature, though it was mild overall. Support in Sept T-bond holds. Floor seen at 114-29/32 to 115-2/32, technicians said. Short-end on hold, traders wait for ECI and payrolls next week.
